verses.text: wajjahtu wajhiya zaa qurbin minal laahi
bijaahi ahmada zaa shawqin ilal laahi
al laahu akbaru mimmaa kuntu afhaluhu
wa lastu akhshaa wa laa arjuu siwal laahi
zikrii wa shukrii wa ridwaanii wa mahmadatii
bil qalbi wal jismi wal aqlaami lil laahi
kulli lahu jalla fii sirrin wa fii halanin
wa  lastu as-alu ghayrun naafihil laahi
rabbaaniyan naanihul wahhaabu ashkuruhu
maadumtu hayyan biqawlil hamdu lil laahi
wa qaaniyad durru takriiman wa wajjaha lii
nafhan bilaa sababin fash shukru lil laahi
al laahu akbaru mimmaa kuntu atlubuhu
wa minhu atlubu kawnil habda lil laahi
al laahu akbaru min haqdii wa min hamalii
wa min maqaa lii fakullii saara lil laahi
lahul wujuudul lazii qad zaanahu qidamun
mahal baqaa-i wa ghayrul laahi lil laahi
lahul baraayaa lahu afhaaluhum wa lahu
makhtaara fii abadin fal amru lil laahi
huwal kariimul lazii abghii karaamatahu
wa kawnuhu liya marjuwwii ladal laahi
fawzii ghadan kawnuhu lii sarmadan wa lahu
amrii ufawwidu bil mukhtaari wal laahi
yadii wa qalbii lahu khillan lahu abadan
zaa khidmatin lirasuulil laahi bil laahi
azkaa salaatin bitasliimin bilaa hadadin
halayhi bil aali wal as-haabimil laahi
yaa rabbi salli wa sallim sarmadan karaman
halaa wasiilatiyal huzmaa ilal laahi
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa wazarii
manik tafaytu bihi fii taahatil laahi
ahnii muhammadanal mukhtaara min mudarin
bil aali was sahbi hizbil maalikil laahi
muhammadun junnatii hanil hisaabi ghadan
wa jannatii fii jinaanil waasihil laahi
mallikniyal haama maa faaqal munaa karaman
yaa mughniyan kulla mudtarin ilal laahi
halayhi salli wa sallim waltutimma bihi
qasdii wa suq liya maa arjuu minal laahi
dahawtukal yawma fil ayyaami murtajiyan
sawaaba man hajja baytar raaziqil laahi
wajjih liyal haama yaa mughnii bilaa kulafin
kashfan wa tayyan wa tawfiqan minal laahi
diinii kitaabuka hallimniihi yaa samadii
bil kashfi wal faydi zaa fahmin hanil laahi
ijhalhu lii abadan nuuran ahuuzu bihi
as safwa wal qurba wal bushraa ladal laahi
tammim muraadii wa saffil humra yaa samadii
wa kun liyad dahra wajhalnii ladal laahi
